Dana Whitlock Reyes
Sacramento, CA | (555) 0134-2087 | dana.w.reyes@example.com
github.com/dwreyes-dev | linkedin.com/in/danawreyes | danareyes.example.dev
SUMMARY
Backend-leaning full-stack engineer with four years of experience building and operating Node.js
and Python services in production. Comfortable owning a feature from schema design through
rollout and on-call. Particular interest in data pipelines, observability, and making slow systems
measurably faster.
EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer II March 2023 – Present
Kestrel Logistics Group — Sacramento, CA
Rebuilt the shipment-tracking ingestion service in TypeScript on Node.js, cutting median event
processing latency from 840 ms to 190 ms and reducing dropped events by 94%.
Designed the partitioning and retention strategy for a 40-million-row PostgreSQL events table,
which held query times under 200 ms as volume tripled over eighteen months.
Introduced contract tests between the dispatch API and three internal consumers, removing the
class of breakage that had caused six production incidents in 2022.
Mentored two junior engineers through their first on-call rotations and wrote the runbooks the
team still uses for ingestion paging alerts.
Software Engineer I July 2021 – February 2023
Northgate Analytics — Remote
Built the customer-facing reporting API (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL) used by roughly 1,200
daily active accounts at time of departure.
Cut the nightly aggregation job from 3 hours 10 minutes to 26 minutes by replacing row-by-row
processing with set-based SQL and a materialized rollup table.
Added structured logging and tracing across eight services, which brought median incident
diagnosis time down from about 45 minutes to under 12.
Software Engineering Intern May 2020 – August 2020
Willowmere Civic Tech — Sacramento, CA
Implemented an accessible address-lookup component used across four public benefit forms.
Wrote the first automated test suite for the intake application, reaching 71% line coverage.
EDUCATION
B.S. Computer Science 2017 – 2021
Bellwater State University — Bellwater, CA
Minor in Statistics. GPA 3.6. Teaching assistant for Data Structures, three semesters.
SKILLS
Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, Go (working knowledge), Bash
Frameworks: Node.js, React, Next.js, FastAPI, Express, Vitest, pytest
Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, dbt, Snowflake
Infrastructure: Docker, Terraform, AWS (ECS, RDS, S3, Lambda), GitHub Actions, Grafana,
OpenTelemetry
PROJECTS
Tideline — github.com/dwreyes-dev/tideline
An open-source CLI that replays PostgreSQL write-ahead log segments into a local test database
so engineers can reproduce production data shapes without copying customer data. Roughly 900
stars; used in the CI pipeline at two companies that have written in.
Slowhand — github.com/dwreyes-dev/slowhand
A small profiling wrapper for Node.js HTTP handlers that attributes latency to individual awaits.
Written up on my blog at danareyes.example.dev/slowhand.
